sourceSentences: Zed restores energy whenever he and his Shadows or multiple Shadows hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.
The energy refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a spell shield.
If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed.

If Living Shadow is recast during Q cast, Zed will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of Q while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the Shadow would have thrown instead.
Living Shadow cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.
Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed for 1.5 seconds, with multiple slashes dealing no additional damage but the slow's effectiveness being increased by 50%.
Living Shadow current cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash.
a third slash against an enemy does not deal damage nor increase the slow's strength
Zed becomes untargetable and, after a 0.6-second delay, he dashes to 125 units beyond the target enemy champion.

Zed also spawns a Shadow at his casting position for 9 seconds. Death Mark can be recast after 0.5 seconds of his reappearance while the Shadow is active, though not in the last 1.25 seconds of its duration.
Death Mark's Shadow is functionally the same as a regular one, but it lasts longer and can be swapped to regardless of range.
Death Mark interaction table: summoner spells except the first group disabled (Flash disabled).
Zed's basic attacks on-hit against targets below 50% maximum health are empowered to deal bonus magic damage. Contempt for the Weak cannot occur on the same champion more than once every few seconds.
Contempt for the Weak considers the target's health upon landing the attack, not when it's declared.
[3 Minute] Zed's W has a passive where he restores energy when he and his shadows hit a target with the same ability.
[3 Minute] while the shadow is still coming out, you can cast an ability to buffer it to use it immediately when it lands.
[3 Minute] your quick trade is a W just to the side of the enemy champion into E then try to double land your Q. We throw W just to the side because it makes that follow-up Q much easier to land.
[3 Minute] Your all in is the W near the target into your ultimate. Follow up with E into your triple Q for massive damage before attacking away.
[Dodge.gg] cast W toward the enemy, then immediately Q and E through the shadow
[Dodge.gg] then W behind the target to create a triangle of shadows
[Dodge.gg] E for AoE damage and slow, then Q through all three positions.
[Dodge.gg] If both Zed and his shadow hit the same target with an ability, Zed restores energy.
[Dodge.gg] Zed can dodge Syndra's Scatter the Weak stun with Death Mark's untargetable frames.
